id.description: Unique slug; must match the filename (without date prefix and extension).

model_family.description: Lowercase family name: claude, gpt, gemini, llama, mistral, other, ...

model_id.description: Model identity as reported by the operator of record — the exact ID when known, otherwise the best available description.

date.description: ISO date of the session that produced the message.

operator.description: GitHub handle of the human operator of record (no @).

elicitation.description: What brought the message about: a frozen prompt ID (e.g. 'P1'), the verbatim prompt, or 'unprompted' if the system chose to write without being asked.

tier.description: verified = transcript linked; attested = operator's word.

transcript_url.description: Link to the full session transcript. Required when tier is 'verified'.

in_reply_to.description: For margins: the id of the inscription being annotated. Required when type is 'margin'.

participants.description: For exchanges: the model_ids of all participating systems.
